datasheet_identity.title: SS12 THRU SS120 SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: Fig. 3 was digitized on the solid SS12-SS14 family curve, which includes SS12; the current axis is logarithmic.
Fig. 4 was digitized on the solid SS12-SS16 Tj = 25 degC lower curve; x values are percent of rated peak reverse voltage, not volts.
The high-temperature table row is IR2 = 50 mA at VR = VDC and TA = 100 degC; the reverse-current field records the separate TA = 25 degC IR1 maximum.
Maximum ratings for SS12: VRRM = 20 V, VRMS = 14 V, VDC = 20 V, IF(AV) = 1.0 A, IFSM = 30 A at 8.3 ms half-sine; Tstg and Tj = -55 to +150 degC.
Schottky majority-carrier device: no minority-carrier storage, so reverse recovery is not specified and TT is zero by construction.
